summary: Midsona AB (publ), a consumer goods company, provides organic and consumer health products and health food products in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway, France, Spain, Germany, the rest of Europe, and internationally. The company offers seeds, breakfast, flours, meal side dishes, oil and vinegar, muesli cereals, dried fruit, nuts, nut butter, spreads, snacks, baking, beans, seeds, lentils, rice, grains, pasta, broth, sauces, oatmeal, drinks, glass and canned goods, kernels, seeds, flakes and flour, crispbread, bread and rice cakes, spices, oils and vinegar, pasta, rice and grains, pasta sauce, toppings, tofu, coconut, tomato, flours and milling, toasted seeds or seed mixes, snowflakes, and savory groceries. It also provides neutral and flavored cookies; tea and beverages; dietary supplements; hair, body, and skin care products; macrobiotics; prepared meals; bakery and sweets; veggieburgers; condiments and spices; and prepared meal products. The company offers its products under the Happy Bio, Helios, Vegetalia, Kung Markatta, Urtekram Kung Markatta, Celnat, Davert, Urtekram Beauty, Friggs, and Earth Control brands. It sells its products through pharmacies, grocery stores, trade, food service, health food stores, and other specialist retailers, as well as operators in the food service and food industries; and online. Midsona AB (publ) was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
